title: Feature Request -  Be able to see outputs from bash commands
body:
**Feature Request**

When running bash commands such as `uv run my_script.py` it would be helpful if you could see the normal outputs of this so you can follow along better. Or at least a flag to see them. Current behavior is just the <Thinking> spinner and no output ( I have tried verbose output mode and the same behavior for bash commands).

Environment Info

    Platform: linux (OpenSUSE Tumbleweed)
    Terminal: xterm-256color (Pycharm Professional 2024.3.3)
    Version: 0.2.27
    Feedback ID: 5f68088b-389a-4d60-8596-4105ca226d70
author: b-burton
